sentences.text:
Mr. K. Venkatramani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 May,
2017
 Mcrc-6241-2017
 (Mr. K. Venkatramani Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
05-05-2017
Mr. Surendra Singh, learned senior counsel with Mr. Ashwini Dubey, counsel for the petitioner.
Issue notice to the Food Inspector Shri H.D. Katare, Food and Drugs Administration, Bhopal.
P.F. within three days by both modes.
I.A. No.7304/2017 is an application for stay of further proceedings in R.T. No 1386/2001 pending in the Court of learned Special Magistrate, Bhopal.

Learned senior counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has argued that the petitioner herein is the nominee of the company, whose prosecution is sought in isolation under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act specially under Section 7 and 16.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has stated that the Company has not been made an accused in the said complaint, which is evident from page 8 which is Annexure A.
On perusal of the complaint, it is evident that the petitioner herein is accused No.3 being the Regional Sales Manager and nominee of Hindustan Lever Ltd.
However, the company Hindustan Lever Ltd., has not been made an accused.

Relying on the decisions in the case of Anita Hada Vs. M/s. Godfather Travels and Tours Pvt. Ltd.,
(2012) 5 SSC 661 and Sharad Kumar Sanghi Vs. Sangita Rane (2015) 12 SCC 781, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has stated that the prosecution cannot be sustained against him on account of company having not been made an accused.
